caseName: Times Square Auto Supply Co. v. Kansas City
caseNameFull: Times Square Auto Supply Company, Inc. v. Kansas City, Missouri
attorneys: Mr. Arthur Miller and Mr. Maurice H. Winger, for appellant, submitted. Mr. Samuel J. McCulloch was also on the brief. Mr. John B. Pew and Mr. Egbert F. Halstead, with whom Mr. Ilus M. Lee was on the brief, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Reversed with costs; and remanded with directions to dismiss for lack of jurisdiction, in that the bill of complaint did not show that the amount involved .was in excess of $3,000. Section 24, Judicial Code, paragraph “First”; Vance v. Vandercook Co., No. 2, 170 U. S. 468, 472; El Paso Water Co. v. El Paso, 152 U. S. 157, 159; Colvin v. Jacksonville, 158 U. S. 456, 459-460.
